name: Halftone
desc: Re-renders the frame as a print halftone: a low-res sample of the canvas becomes an ink-dot grid whose dots swell with darkness and breathe with the music; newsprint, CMYK misregistration, duotone and LED-jumbotron screens.

cell.doc: dot-grid cell size (bigger = chunkier, fewer dots)

contrast.doc: tonal contrast of the dot sizing

angle.doc: screen angle (sheen sweep + dot registration axis)

style.doc: aesthetic: black ink dots on paper / 4-color CMYK misregistered screens (abstract) / two-ink duotone / emissive RGB LED jumbotron matrix

act.doc: multi-minute program: print steady, registration drifts the CMYK screens apart, scan speeds a reveal sweep
